Scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When choosing between two possibilities in an embedded question, use 是……还是…… rather than A-not-A plus 或者. [rule: a_not_a_question]
Run 2: 吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When the uncertainty is between two named alternatives, use 是……还是……; 吃不吃 asks whether he ate at all rather than which plant he ate. [rule: a_not_a_question]
Run 3: 吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，This is a choice between two plants, so use “是……还是……” rather than the yes/no form “吃不吃” plus “或者”. [rule: a_not_a_question]

output.reason: All runs identify the same issue, but their fix changes the intended meaning from whether Shennong should eat them to which plant he ate, unlike the teacher’s 要不要吃 correction.
